## Partner v0.2.0

A feature release. Other programs can now use Partner's memory without joining its conversation: each Memory Service is an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint on its own `127.0.0.1` port that forwards to a real model and adds what Partner remembers to each request. The memory store gains an `origin` column (schema v3, migrated automatically on first start); the session and settings formats are otherwise unchanged.

## New

- **Memory Service.** Add, edit and remove endpoints on the new Services page. Each one passes requests through to the upstream model unchanged — tools, `stream`, `tool_calls`, SSE frames, usage and errors included — and changes only three things: the model name, a block of recalled memory in front of the last user message, and an optional custom prompt (empty by default). On a configurable interval it summarizes what was asked and answered into one sentence, tagged `[对外服务:<name>]`, and writes it to the main memory.
- **Memory origins.** Memories written by a service are labelled on the Memory page and can be filtered by service. They never retire main-session memories, and deleting a conversation does not delete them; deleting the service offers to remove them.
- **Separate credentials.** Every service has its own generated token (at least 32 characters, shown once), accepted as `Authorization: Bearer` or `x-api-key`. The client's credential is never forwarded; the upstream key stays in the settings.
- **Pass-through, not conversion.** A service's protocol must match its upstream's. A mismatch is refused when saving, and a configuration that drifts later answers `502` without contacting the upstream.
